    Official NVIDIA DLSS 5 (featuring 3D-Guided Neural Rendering) support varies by graphics card generation, as tracked by the DLSS 5 Supported Cards & GPU Compatibility Checker: 
    Confirmed Official Support
    • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series (Desktop & Laptop):
      RTX 5090

      , and corresponding Laptop GPUs (plus RTX Spark laptops) have native, out-of-the-box support for DLSS 5 and
      DLSS 4.5 Dynamic 6X MFG
      .       
    Planned Official Support
    • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 Series:
      RTX 4090
      Go to product viewer dialog for this item.
      down to
      RTX 4060
      Go to product viewer dialog for this item.
      are officially planned to receive native DLSS 5 support from NVIDIA, though no public release date has been set yet      .       
    Unsupported / No Official Support
    • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 30 Series & RTX 20 Series:
      These cards do not have official native DLSS 5 support from NVIDIA (they remain limited to DLSS 3.5 / Super Resolution / Ray Reconstruction). However, community modding tools like OptiScaler, DLSS Swapper, and DLSS Unlocked allow users to manually enable DLSS 5 features on RTX 20-, 30-, and 40-series cards, though performance can be heavy.
       
    • NVIDIA GeForce GTX Series & AMD / Intel GPUs: GTX 10-series cards have no DLSS support. AMD Radeon and Intel Arc cards rely on FSR or XeSS instead, though community mods have experimented with porting DLSS 5 traits to select AMD hardware (like RX 7000/9000 series) with varying performance.
